q: The main source of irrigation in Andhra Pradesh is
explanation:
Most books and keys: canals. Strictly: groundwater – wells and tube wells together – is now the largest source (about 48% of GIA in 2023-24 vs canals about 40%) (old app notes 3:115 sub 0; AP Socio-Economic Survey 2024-25).
Canals are the answer most books give (delta canals of the Godavari and Krishna); counted together, wells and tube wells now irrigate more area.

notes.text: - Older books: "**canals** are the main source in AP" (deltas); now groundwater (wells + tube wells together) leads.
